mapper.select: select * from tj_sic where year=#{year} and month=#{month} and day=#{day} and var_model="SIC_Ice-BCNet"
select * from tj_sic where year=#{year} and month=#{month} and var_model like concat('%', #{year}, '%')
select * from tj_sic where year=#{year} and var_model like '%DA%'
SELECT DISTINCT year FROM tj_sic ORDER BY year DESC
SELECT year, month, day FROM tj_sic ORDER BY CAST(year AS UNSIGNED) DESC, CAST(month AS UNSIGNED) DESC, CAST(day AS UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1
